subject: Evaluation milestone playlist and contract sequencing for MedForge
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sally Tran <sally.tran@medforge.com>; Procurement Team <procurement@medforge.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-06-27T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Evaluation milestone playlist and sequencing proposal

Hi Sally / MedForge procurement team —

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. Attached is a compact "playlist" that sequences evaluation milestones (pilot acceptance, load window, SLA tests) to contract checkpoints so legal / procurement have clear handoffs rather than parallel back-and-forth. See attached: MedForge_MAP_v3.xlsx.

High-level asks:
- Can you confirm the internal procurement lead for formal PO timing? (we need a name and target week)
- Who should receive the DPA redlines from your side? Alicia from our counsel is copied if you want legal-to-legal chat.
- Target signature window: MedForge asked for mid-August; we proposed Aug 16–20 as a backstop. If that conflicts with internal month-end approvals, flag alternative weeks.

Proposed sequencing (short):
1) Security questionnaire + SOC2 evidence (2 wks) — start now.
2) DPA redline cycle + legal sync (3 wks) — simultaneous but requires counsel review.
3) Pilot acceptance (runbook + success criteria) — scheduled during DPA review so procurement can review scopes.
4) Order form (SOW) finalization + PO issuance — after pilot acceptance sign-off.

I've included a draft SOW and a one-page acceptance checklist in the spreadsheet. If we can get a procurement point of contact and an estimated PO date by EOD Thu, I'll slot internal meetings with Laura and Karthik to lock the DPA cadence.

Next steps (suggested):
- Sally: confirm procurement lead and any fixed blackout dates for approvals.
- MedForge legal: send initial redlines (we can take them in DocuSign or PDF).
- Redwood: we'll produce an Evidence packet and proposed signatory list.

Attachments: [attachment: MedForge_MAP_v3.xlsx], [attachment: SOW_draft.docx]

Thanks,
Vivek
VP, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

From: Sally Tran <sally.tran@medforge.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@medforge.com>, Tom Baker <tbaker@medforge.com>
Date: 2027-06-27T12:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Evaluation milestone playlist and sequencing proposal

Vivek — thanks for the clear write-up and the playlist. Quick responses:

- Procurement lead: Tom Baker (cc'd) will own PO timing and internal approvals.
- Legal: we prefer PDF redlines first; I'll loop Alicia (external counsel) if needed — otherwise send to procurement@medforge.com.
- Blackout windows: July 19–22 is a finance close blackout for approvals (we cannot get signatures then).

We like the proposed sequencing. MedForge's preferred target for signature is week of Aug 9, which gives us two weeks buffer before your mid-August backstop. If the DPA review slips, we'll risk pushing to Aug 23.

I'll ask Tom to provide an estimated PO issue date by Friday EOD. In the meantime, procurement will start the vendor setup and confirm required vendor forms.

Regards,
Sally
Director, Strategic Procurement
MedForge Health

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwoodinference.com>, Sally Tran <sally.tran@medforge.com>
Date: 2027-06-28T08:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Evaluation milestone playlist and sequencing proposal — draft sequencing

Hi all —

I took Vivek's playlist and sketched a sequencing grid that maps legal/procurement gates to the MAP milestones. Major assumptions are spelled out in the first tab of the spreadsheet; attaching a redline baseline for DPA so we have a starting point.

Draft sequencing summary (calendar weeks):
- W1–W2 (now → Jul 10): Security questionnaire + SOC2 evidence collection (owner: Redwood ops + MedForge security)
- W2–W5 (Jul 5 → Jul 26): DPA redline cycle (legal exchanges + counsels meeting). Target to get to final markups by Jul 26.
- W4–W6 (Jul 19 → Aug 2): Pilot run + acceptance tests (we can run acceptance in parallel with late-stage legal review).
- W6–W7 (Aug 2 → Aug 9): Order form / SOW finalization, pricing reconciliation and internal approvals.
- W7 (week of Aug 9): Preferred signature week (per MedForge).

Risk and fallback: if DPA redlines push past Jul 26, move acceptance earlier (compress) or accept a partial go-live with limited scope, and target Aug 23 signature as backup. We should confirm escalation owners for each gate.

Attachments: [attachment: DPA_redlines_v1.pdf] — initial baseline for internal review.

I'll volunteer to run the weekly 30-min sync with Laura and Tom to keep timelines honest; propose Tuesdays 10:00 PT starting Jul 6, subject to Tom's availability.

-Karthik
Director, Contracts & Onboarding
Redwood Inference

From: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@lawfirm.com>

Cc: Tom Baker <tbaker@medforge.com>
Date: 2027-06-28T14:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Evaluation milestone playlist and sequencing proposal — DPA coordination

Hi team —

Thanks for the ping. I reviewed the baseline DPA that Karthik shared. A few high-level points:
- We'll need to clarify data residency language around backups and subprocessor lists (I can draft alternate clauses).
- Liability caps: MedForge is likely to ask for a carve-out related to data incidents during pilot. We can propose a limited carve-out and a true-up process tied to SLA outcomes.
- Preferred workflow: initial PDF redlines, followed by a counsel-to-counsel call; please confirm what times next week work for all.

DocuSign is fine for signatures; suggest reserving signature slots Aug 9–11 for primary signatories and Aug 16–20 as backup. I'll prepare a redline set and send by EOD Jul 1.

Attachments: [attachment: Alicia_initial_notes.txt]

Best,
Alicia Gomez
Partner, Regulatory & Data Privacy
Fairview Law Partners

To: Sally Tran <sally.tran@medforge.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@medforge.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>, Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@lawfirm.com>
Date: 2027-06-29T16:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Evaluation milestone playlist and sequencing proposal — consolidated plan and next steps

Thanks everyone — good momentum. Summary and asks below so we have a single source of truth:

Consolidated timeline (confirmed):
- Security evidence collection: complete by Jul 10 (owner: Redwood ops + MedForge security).
- DPA redline exchange: Jul 5 → Jul 26 (Alicia will send redlines by Jul 1; Karthik to coordinate counsel call during W3).
- Pilot window: Jul 19 → Aug 2 (acceptance criteria documented in MAP spreadsheet).
- SOW finalization & PO: Jul 26 → Aug 9 (Tom to target PO issuance in this window).
- Target signature: week of Aug 9 (Aug 9–13); backup Aug 16–20 if required.

Immediate next actions:
- Tom (MedForge): confirm PO issuance date by this Friday EOD.
- Alicia: share redline set by Jul 1.
- Laura: assemble the Evidence packet and vendor setup checklist; Laura will ping security for SOC2 access.
- Karthik: schedule the weekly 30-min sync Tuesdays 10:00 PT starting Jul 6 (tentative).

I'll prepare a short operating note (one page) that tracks owners, escalation contacts, and the evidence bucket for buyers. We'll also add a DocuSign template link into the MAP folder to reserve signature slots.

Attachments included across thread: [attachment: MedForge_MAP_v3.xlsx], [attachment: SOW_draft.docx], [attachment: DPA_redlines_v1.pdf]

If there are no objections, I'll schedule the Tuesday cadence and circulate the one-page operating note by Tue morning.

Thanks,
Vivek
VP, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
